ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The image shows the deflection trajectories of four charged particles after being injected into a uniform magnetic field at point \( O \) in the same direction, perpendicular to the magnetic field lines. The magnetic field direction is out of the plane of the paper. The masses of the four particles are equal, and their charges are also equal. The trajectory of the negatively charged particle with the greatest kinetic energy is:

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a rectangular region, and the magnetic field symbol shows \(\vec B\) perpendicular to the paper surface outward; point \(O\) is at the right edge of the rectangle, and the particle enters from \(O\) and moves to the left. There are four curved trajectories starting from \(O\) in the figure; the ones deflecting upward are labeled \(Oa\) and \(Ob\), and the ones deflecting downward are labeled \(Oc\) and \(Od\). Among the two trajectories deflecting downward, \(Oc\) bends more gently and has a larger circular radius, while \(Od\) bends more sharply and has a smaller radius. Reasoning: The velocity direction is to the left, and the magnetic field direction is outward. Using the right-hand rule to judge, a positive charge is subjected to a force upward, and a negative charge is subjected to a force downward, so the candidate trajectories corresponding to negative charges are \(Oc\) and \(Od\). When undergoing circular deflection in a uniform magnetic field, \(r=mv/(|q|B)\). The problem states that the particle masses are equal, the charge magnitudes are equal, and the magnetic field is the same; therefore the larger the radius, the greater the velocity, and the greater the kinetic energy \(K=\frac12 mv^2\). Since the radius of \(Oc\) is larger than that of \(Od\), the trajectory with the greatest kinetic energy among the negative charges is \(Oc\).

method.method_draft: Identify the sign first: from the image, with velocity from O toward the left and B out of the page, use the right-hand rule to see that negative particles must curve downward, so the candidate trajectories are Oc and Od. Then compare their curvature in the image: Oc has the gentler bend/larger circular radius than Od. Since the text states the masses and charges are equal and the field is uniform, larger radius means larger speed and larger kinetic energy. Therefore select Oc.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个矩形区域，磁场符号显示 \(\vec B\) 垂直纸面向外；点 \(O\) 在矩形右侧边缘，粒子从 \(O\) 射入并向左运动。图中有四条从 \(O\) 出发的弯曲轨迹，向上偏转的标为 \(Oa\)、\(Ob\)，向下偏转的标为 \(Oc\)、\(Od\)。在两条向下偏转的轨迹中，\(Oc\) 的弯曲更缓、圆周半径更大，\(Od\) 的弯曲更急、半径更小。推理：速度方向向左，磁场方向向外，用右手定则判断，正电荷受力向上，负电荷受力向下，所以负电荷对应候选轨迹是 \(Oc\) 和 \(Od\)。在匀强磁场中做圆周偏转时 \(r=mv/(|q|B)\)。题设粒子质量相等、电荷量相等且磁场相同，因此半径越大，速度越大，动能 \(K=\frac12 mv^2\) 越大。由于 \(Oc\) 的半径比 \(Od\) 大，所以负电荷中动能最大的轨迹是 \(Oc\)。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Uses the standard physics route: first classify sign from deflection direction using the Lorentz-force direction, then rank kinetic energy by curvature radius. This is the direct and essentially unique solution path for the diagram.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read from the figure that the magnetic field is out of the page, the particles enter the field from point O on the right moving initially leftward, the upper trajectories are labeled Oa and Ob, and the lower trajectories are labeled Oc and Od. Among the lower trajectories, Oc bends more gently and has the larger radius of curvature than Od.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the problem statement facts that all four particles are injected in the same direction perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field, their masses are equal, and their charges are equal in magnitude; the requested particle is negatively charged and has the greatest kinetic energy.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply the Lorentz force rule F = q v × B: for motion initially to the left with B out of the page, positive charges deflect upward and negative charges deflect downward. In uniform magnetic field circular motion, r = mv/(|q|B), and with equal mass and equal charge magnitude, greater kinetic energy corresponds to larger speed and hence larger radius of curvature.
